messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A long weekend is defined as a holiday that falls on a weekday (or is observed on a weekday) and is adjacent to a weekend (Saturday + Sunday).  

| Date(s) | Holiday | Observed (if different) | Notes |
|---------|---------|--------------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day | Observed Mon 2 | Sunday 1 + Monday 2 + Tuesday 3 |
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Ontario, BC, AB, SK, NB, NS, PEI, NL) | – | Monday 20 |
| **Feb 4 – 6** | Family Day (Quebec) | – | Monday 6 |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | – | Friday 7 + weekend |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | – | Monday 22 |
| **Jun 30 – 2** | Canada Day (observed Jun 30) | Observed Fri 30 | Saturday 1 + weekend |
| **Aug 5 – 7** | Civic Holiday (ON) / BC Day / AB Day / NB Day / NS Day / PEI Day / NL Day | – | Monday 7 |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | – | Monday 4 |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | – | Monday 9 |
| **Nov 10 – 12** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 10) | Observed Fri 10 | Saturday 11 + weekend |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas | – | Saturday 23 + Monday 25 |
| **Dec 24 – 26** | Boxing Day (not a long weekend) | – | Tuesday 26 |

### Provincial/territorial holidays that create long weekends (in addition to the federal list)

| Province/Territory | Holiday | Date | Long‑Weekend |
|--------------------|---------|------|--------------|
| **Quebec** | St. Jean Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Fri) | Jun 24 – 26 |
| **Ontario** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **British Columbia** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Alberta** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Saskatchewan** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **New Brunswick** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Nova Scotia** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Prince Edward Island** | Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18 – 20 |
| **Ontario** | Civic Holiday | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **British Columbia** | BC Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **Alberta** | Alberta Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **New Brunswick** | New Brunswick Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **Nova Scotia** | Nova Scotia Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **Prince Edward Island** | PEI Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |
| **Newfoundland & Labrador** | NL Day | Aug 7 (Mon) | Aug 5 – 7 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Use the federal list for a nationwide view.  
> - If you need province‑specific long weekends, merge the provincial table above.  
> - Remember that holidays observed on a weekday (e.g., Canada Day observed on Friday) still create a long weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a specific format (JSON, CSV, etc.) or if you need additional details such as the exact day of the week for each holiday.
